header: PHASE B confirmation seeds 300-309. Not pooled with phase A.
label: GRADED JOINT REVERSION EXCEEDS BOTH FIRST-ORDER-MATCHED AND ISOTROPIC CONTROLS (PREFIX FUNCTION): REPLICATED
verdict_paragraph: In W2, in at least eight of ten fresh GRU-8 seeds, continuation-stage joint recurrent reversion produced a trapezoidal excess prefix-function loss exceeding every one of 32 first-order-matched paths and every one of 32 isotropic paths. Both families matched the reversion displacement block by block in Frobenius norm; the first-order-matched family additionally matched its initial loss derivative. The excess met the declared materiality threshold, and the intact trained cores outperformed the prefix-blind reference. This supports a bounded causal contribution under the specified intervention and fixed surrounding computation. The comparison concerns the sampled families and dose-averaged AUC; it does not identify semantic content, curvature as a mechanism, localization, necessity, or selectivity over continuation processing.
